svg.title: Unified Capture Visual Design Suite (Family Cookbook Era 3)
svg.desc: Complete Era 3 visual design specification covering all 9 What's for Supper Capture screens: Entry Hub, collapsed Photo Staging, Web Link Review, Describe and Generate, Import PDF Confirmation, Hero-led Import Shared .txt File (with editable Rating and Notes, no confusing Original pill), Preview Steps expanded disclosure, Active Upload and Inline Error states, Settings Failed Captures inline confirm and Demo Mode, plus stripe-free Home async feedback, Paired Duplicate Review, Era 3 RecipeImportIssueSheet, French expansion, and High Contrast AAA proofs.
svg.text: WFS / Shared Table · Family Cookbook Era 3 · Capture & Import Suite
Save & Return Home · Standard AA & AAA
Complete 9-screen specification: Header + × → Source → Duplicate advisory below source → Your Rating & Notes → Hearth CTA, plus expanded preview, upload/error & recovery states.
1 · Primary Capture Screens: Identical Vertical Rhythm, Zero Layout Jump & Consistent Metadata

g.text: From any recipe website or blog
Name & family notes. We’ll draft it.
• Open warm-cream header (no legacy divider bar).
• Calm photo CTA (no extra instructional clutter).
• Home trigger: "Photo, link, PDF, or idea".
Tap a photo to mark or clear the main dish cover.
• Hub collapses once staged; "+ Add photo" in grid.
returns straight to Home (no 10s wait screen).
We’ll fetch ingredients and steps once you save.
Already in your library: Creamy Garlic Pasta
• Duplicate banner sits directly below Link URL,
input never shifts downward under your thumb.
• Same slot as Describe & Shared .txt below.
We’ll draft ingredients and steps with AI so you can
Already in your library: Our family spaghetti
Slow-simmered beef & pork meat sauce with
crushed tomatoes, oregano, bay leaf, and
grated carrots for the kids. Serves 6.
HONEST TOP SUBTITLE · CLEAN CTA FOOTER
• AI disclosure lives calmly under the title (no
disclaimer box stacked over the Save button).
• Duplicate banner sits right below Recipe name.
PDF recipe · up to 10 pages · 20 MiB
One recipe per PDF · pages stay viewable later.
Add pinch of clove; double pastry
• Drops idle upload-lock footnote above Save.
• Active saving & error states shown on Screen 8.
Already in your library: Classic Shepherd’s Pie
• Generous hero photo + filename + photo count.
• Importer sets Rating & Notes below advisory.

svg.text: 2 · Secondary & Transitional Screens: Preview Steps, Active Upload / Errors, Settings Failed Captures & Demo Mode

g.text: • 1 can creamed corn · 4 cups mashed potatoes
Brown ground beef with diced onion and garlic
in a large skillet until no pink remains.
Season with salt, pepper, and Worcestershire.
Layer beef, creamed corn, and mashed potatoes.
Bake at 375°F for 25 minutes until golden.
Matches RecipeDetailSheet Garden headings & step badges.
ZERO EXTRA MODAL · SAME PATTERN AS TONIGHT
• Preserves your Rating & Notes below while open.
A · SLOW PHOTO UPLOAD OVERLAY (> 800ms ONLY)
We’ll take you home as soon as they’re saved.
Hearth pulse ring · opaque cream in High Contrast
B · PDF ACTIVE SAVING (STATUS ONLY WHILE IN FLIGHT)
We’ll take you home as soon as your PDF is saved.
C · INLINE VALIDATION / UNCERTAIN UPLOAD ERROR
Try again, or check your library first. Another
• Upload wait messages appear ONLY while active.
• Form draft (photos, URL, rating, notes) is never
wiped on network failure or rejection.
• Stable button dimensions prevent finger shifts.
B · DEMO MODE ON /CAPTURE (AI OFF · .TXT ACTIVE)
AI capture is turned off in this demo. Explore
prepared recipes or import a shared .txt file.
confirm puts Keep left + danger blush right.
• Demo gate upgrades to a 48px secondary button

svg.text: 3 · Save-and-Return-Home Async Feedback (Calm Cards, No Left Stripes), Duplicate Review & Issue Sheet

g.text: A · AMBIENT IN-FLIGHT STATUS ON HOME (RIGHT AFTER SAVE → HOME)
Carry on. We’ll let you know when it’s in your library.
C · PERSISTENT FAILURE BANNER (SSE recipe_failed · SINGLE DISMISS)
Recipe couldn’t be saved: Grandma’s Tourtière.
Your original file is still safe. Retry now or manage later in Settings.
• In-flight uses Hearth pulsing dot (keeps Ochre for voting & Garden for ready/settled).
• Secondary "+ Add another" button is crisp white; failure banner drops duplicate X & left stripe.
Keep existing · move new to Bin
Keep new · move existing to Bin
Moved copies stay recoverable in Recycle Bin.
Add a note to request automatic repair.
Removes this recipe from Needs review.
HOW YOU REACH PAIRED DUPLICATE REVIEW (3 DIRECT PATHS)
1. Tap LibraryToast (“Possible duplicate · Tap to review”) right when import finishes.
2. Recipes → Filters → Reported (or Needs review pill) → tap card → inline “Compare & resolve”.
3. Tap the Reported badge or “Review issue” inside RecipeDetailSheet’s ••• menu.
